d: New Zealand resumed Day 2 at 243/5 but were bowled out for 368, thanks to India's pacers, led by Jasprit Bumrah (4/92). In reply, India got off to a flying start with a 130-run opening stand between Yashasvi Jaiswal (85) and KL Rahul, who remained unbeaten on 52. Alongside Devdutt Padikkal (16), Rahul guided India to 159/1 at stumps, leaving them 209 runs behind New Zealand.
